justification: Adds a preview-only switch, LOOKUP_FAIL_CHECKS, that makes named lookup checks (planning_layers, lot_shape, tod, roads, precinct) fail through their own failure path, so a person can read the Not checked notice on a real preview page. It is ignored when VERCEL_ENV is production.

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: unset or empty switch fails nothing
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: only lookups on a deploy where the variable is set

functions.name: forcedLookupFailure
functions.input: the name of one lookup check, read against two environment variables
functions.output: an Error when the switch names the check on a non-production deploy, else null
functions.if_none: unset switch or production returns null

break_it.scenario: someone sets LOOKUP_FAIL_CHECKS on the production Vercel environment
break_it.what_happens: real users would see Not checked for working checks
break_it.how: returns null when VERCEL_ENV is production; unit test covers it

break_it.scenario: the switch lists names with spaces after commas
break_it.what_happens: a named check might not fail
break_it.how: names are trimmed; unit test covers it

break_it.scenario: a check is forced to fail that already answered with real data
break_it.what_happens: its real facts could still be shown beside a Not checked notice
break_it.how: settle throws after the fetch, so the answer is dropped and the fact stays null exactly as on a real failure

post_merge.manual_verify: set LOOKUP_FAIL_CHECKS=precinct on a preview deploy, open /assessment for an address, read the notice

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the switch fires on production, ignores a named check, or fires when unset
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main: forcedLookupFailure does not exist, so the test cannot import it
